svg.title: JATMN — building, contributing, reviewing
svg.desc: Last 30 days: 125 commits, 73 pull requests opened, and 89 distinct PRs reviewed. Past-year totals appear below each figure. Both charts show separate daily commit, opened pull request, and reviewed-PR counts. Reviews count distinct PRs in each daily or summary window. Only public repository names are shown.
svg.text: Totals may include private activity; repository names are public only.
Reviews count distinct PRs per day; summaries deduplicate across the period.
